import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Split at the uniform separator line/column. Mark aligned cells that match.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if all(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in grid):
        sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
        top = grid[:sep]
        bottom = grid[sep + 1:]
        return [[3 if top[r][c] == bottom[r][c] else top[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(top))]
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else left[r][c] for c in range(sep)] for r in range(h)]
'''
open(p,'w').write(source)
print(p, os.path.exists(p))
